## Whisper to Notes

Drop in a recording, get structured meeting notes back — transcription
and summarisation both on your own hardware.

```
audio -> whisper (transcribe) -> llama-server (structure) -> JSON notes
```

**Call it:**
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/ods-notes \
  -F 'file=@standup.m4a' -F 'title=Monday standup'
```

Optional form fields: `title`, `stt_model`.

Returns `summary`, `decisions`, `action_items` and `open_questions`, plus
the full `transcript` so nothing is lost to summarisation.

The model is asked for JSON and the workflow parses it defensively — if
it answers with prose instead, you still get the transcript and the raw
reply rather than a failed execution.
